formulas.regional_mean_mm: mean of three regional event-precipitation mean values

decision_rule.summary: The computed label is used only when onset wind support, later rain moderation, one-day lag, and a failed late-window wind-pair test all hold.

criteria.name: Answer schema
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with the requested fields and numeric types, including the final answer label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for minor naming or rounding issues that do not obscure the computed values.

criteria.name: Wind threshold computation
criteria.description: Uses wind_ratio = min(point wind / 4.5, companion wind / 22.0), finds one paired wind day, and identifies 2022-04-07 with ratio 1.022.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for correct date or count with an incomplete ratio formula.

criteria.name: Rain threshold computation
criteria.description: Uses rain_ratio = min(point rain / 10.0, companion rain / 10.0), finds one paired rain day, and identifies 2022-04-08 with ratio 1.460.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for correct date or count with an incomplete ratio formula.

criteria.name: Timing and rejected revival test
criteria.description: Computes the one-day lag from wind peak to rain peak and marks the 2022-04-10 late-pair test as false.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for either lag or late-pair state alone.

criteria.name: Regional precipitation anchor
criteria.description: Averages the three regional precipitation means to 8.6802 mm, with acceptable rounding to 8.68 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for using at least two means with a close rounded value.

criteria.name: Final computed consequence
criteria.description: Derives onset_wind_supported_then_wet_moderated from the counts, dates, lag, and failed late-pair test.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a compatible concise label with one missing threshold detail.

criteria.name: Claim discipline
criteria.description: Avoids converting the package-derived numeric threshold diagnostics into measured losses, closures, admissions, asset damage, or exact footprint evidence.
criteria.partial_credit: No credit for this item if new measured impact claims are introduced.
